name: Sheep & Socks
description:
About This Game

Sheep & Socks is a chaotic local cooperation game where you and your friends play as shepherd dogs to produce clothes for the local animals. Herd the sheep into the shearing machine, collect their wool and bring the "fancy" clothes to the customers. Discover diverse levels as you progress through the different regions. Each location is a new challenge that you'll need to master in order to get the max score!

Sheep herding

You can bark at the sheep to move them around but they are not very smart and might not go where you want. That's why it's easier together, call a friend and maneuver this flocks through the pasture for maximum efficiency!

Coordinate

Several tasks are much quicker to execute with 2 or more players like washing the sheep and bringing the wool to the machine. Organise yourselves and manage your time to finish those tasks quickly.

Animal customers

Turtles, reindeers, Ostriches and other animals come to your shop to get fancy wool clothes. Serve them in time to increase your score … and witness their peculiar sense of fashion.

Various regions

Each region comes with a new vibe, new tools and new ways to interact with your sheep!
short_desc: Guide goofy flocks of sheep and produce fancy socks in this frantic couch coop game! Good coordination with your fellow shepherd dogs is key to meet the animal clients demand. Get ready and bark away!
